_comment: Explicit numbered scalar caption policy, replayed by _shared/lua/test/menu_numbered_caption_contract.lua on macOS and Linux. A numbered command row declares caption_format "numbered" and an i18n caption that holds the one placeholder {1}; the row's caption getter supplies the value. entry point: the menu renderer's command_row, template_rows and build for a frame holding one such row {type: command, id: native_action, i18n: <caption key>, caption_getter: native_value, caption_format: numbered}, with the i18n text set to `format` and the getter answering `value` (default: the literal text "Native% $& {1}", whose percent, dollar, ampersand and {1} must come out untouched). positive: the label must equal `expected` in all three entry points and nothing may run before the row is activated. grammar_refusals: a `format` outside the grammar (exactly one {1}) yields no row and no template. ownership_refusals: the row is first changed by `mutation`, then it yields no row and no template.

drivers.windows: Not ported: one AHK consumer must build the frame row above in the Windows menu engine, apply the named mutation and compare the label or the refusal.

ownership_refusals.mutation: the getter raises "native caption reader refused"
